name: What factors influence the pricing of a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the pricing of a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condo pricing is primarily influenced by location, views, amenities, square footage, condition, and recent comparable sales. Premium features like waterfront access, penthouse status, or high-end smart home technology can significantly increase value. For properties in areas like Fisher Island or Bal Harbour, the exclusivity of the community itself is a major factor, alongside the quality of on-site services and resident-only facilities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key factors include location, views, amenities, size, condition, and recent sales data, with community exclusivity and services playing a major role in luxury markets.
